run_benchmark_qknorm_rope: run the diffusion qknorm + rope performance benchmark comparing split vs fused implementations
create_cos_sin_cache: create a rotary embedding cosine/sine cache tensor for a given rotary dimension and max sequence length
make_inputs: make benchmark input tensors for a given CaseSpec configuration including q, k, weights, positions, and cos_sin_cache
clone_inputs: clone benchmark input tensors to preserve originals across multiple benchmark iterations
run_split_qknorm_rope: run the split qknorm + rope pipeline using separate fused_inplace_qknorm and flashinfer apply_rope calls
run_fused_qknorm_rope: run the fused qknorm + rope pipeline using sglang's fused_inplace_qknorm_rope kernel
